name: 102-robust-skip-into-failing-inflight
description: Robustness: segment 4 takes 1.5 s and fails twice (retries after 2 and 4 s). While 3 plays, a +18 s skip lands about 1 s into 4, the build's in-flight fetch. The player holds the build through the failures (Error while nothing can play) and lands 18 s on, playing, once 4 arrives about 10.5 s after load.
